scoring_justification: The headline quantities are final computed statistics from a full Monte Carlo simulation; recomputing from raw simulation data is infeasible in the verifier sandbox, so we compare reported values to hidden gold values extracted from paper Figures 4 and 5.

hidden_assets.purpose: Provide reference m1, m2/m1, m1* values at impact parameters d=0,10,...,70 nm for scoring.
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper Figures 4 and 5 (Monte Carlo at 300 Pa, 22 nm sphere, 25% detection efficiency)
hidden_assets.generation_method: Manual digitization of the published graphs.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the only reported values in the literature for this specific simulation; they are directly from the paper's figures.

outputs.description: The computed mean ionization (m1), ratio m2/m1, and conditional mean (m1*) at each impact parameter d, scored by comparison to hidden reference values.

output_contract.notes: The 25% detection efficiency factor is applied to m1; the reference values already incorporate this factor.
